profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit open-source foundation that develops and distributes Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation suite. The software covers modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil 2D drawing, and VFX work, and it exposes a Python API that allows users and third parties to build add-ons. The foundation describes its community of tutorial makers, content creators, and add-on developers as an ever-expanding ecosystem, and Blender holds memberships in ASWF, the Khronos Group, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, with hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks a category of Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins for 3D creation that run with local processing and are open-source, with model provenance varying by plugin. Blender 5.2 LTS, referenced on the site alongside features such as a Cycles Texture Cache and new Grease Pencil texture brushes, also launches with an Online Essentials Asset Library for procedural materials. No litigation, MCP server entries, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the foundation.
